preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 for N in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.islower() and S.isalpha() for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string S contains only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(S) for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)]) <= 1000000
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings S over all test cases does not exceed 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' or (return_value == 'YES' and isinstance(operations, int) and operations >= 0)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'NO' if any(S[i] != S[-i-1] for i in range(len(S)//2) for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)]) else True
postconditions.description: The output is 'NO' if it is impossible to make the string a palindrome; otherwise, it is 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' and operations == sum((S[i] != S[-i-1]) for i in range(len(S)//2) for S in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the number of operations is equal to the number of mismatched character pairs in the string.
